correctness.rationale: The deterministic necessity is checked using a private singleton approver for each cohesive candidate c: any W omitting c fails both SJR (no elected common candidate of N_c) and SSJR (that singleton voter is unrepresented). Sufficiency holds for every cohesive G via any common c in G, necessarily in H. A union bound makes the private-supporter failure <=m(1-q(1-q)^(m-1))^n. Candidate approval columns are independent, hence |H| is exactly Bin(m,b_n); coupling controls complete families and TV for their counts without falsely conditioning on the singleton event. The LLN and triangular-array CLT at q_n=1/k+lambda/sqrt(n) imply the stated thresholds, including the positive-cohesion conditional denominator. Boundary n=1 and the m>k requirement are explicit. Read actual RESULT.md blob 923f3d... and standalone verify.py blob 26d2d4..., which independently loops literal cohesive groups and profiles; full 78,664-profile run not independently executed here. Finite checks are not substituted for the analytic proof.
